column1: # Blinter security findings accepted as they stand, one per line: the rule
# code, the file and the text of the line, separated by tabs.
# .github/workflows/script-security.yml says what reads this file and when
# a line is added or removed.

column3: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& { $src = $env:INS_SRC; $dest = $env:INS_DEST; $name = Split-Path -Leaf $dest; $want = Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $src; if (-not $want) { Write-Host ('Error: cannot hash the source of ' + $name + '.'); exit 1 } foreach ($i in 1..5) { try { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Host ('Error: copying ' + $name + ' failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 1 } $got = Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $dest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($got -and $got.Hash -eq $want.Hash) { exit 0 } Write-Host ('Warning: ' + $name + ' corrupted on write (attempt ' + $i + '/5); retrying...') } Write-Host ('Error: ' + $name + ' still corrupt after 5 attempts.'); Write-Host 'The destination filesystem may be unreliable.'; exit 1 }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "& { try { $file = $env:PPK_FILE; %PIN_READER_PS%; $unless = ' unless PORTANODE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=1 is set.'; if ($pins.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output ('gpg: found, but ' + $env:PPK_NAME + ' pins no key -- verification would refuse ' + $env:PPK_WHAT + $unless); exit 0 }; if ($min.Length -gt 9 -or $pins.Count -lt [int]$min) { Write-Output ('gpg: found, but ' + $env:PPK_NAME + ' pins ' + $pins.Count + ' key(s), fewer than the ' + $min + ' signatures it asks for -- verification would refuse ' + $env:PPK_WHAT + $unless); exit 0 }; foreach ($p in ($pins.Keys | Sort-Object)) { Write-Output ('Pinned key ' + $p + ' in ' + $env:PPK_NAME + '.') }; Write-Output ('Verification asks for ' + $min + ' good signature(s) from distinct pinned keys.') } catch { Write-Output ('Error: ' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 1 }; exit 0 }"
